========================================
Attribute-like macros in declaration specifiers
========================================

__IO uint32_t ISER[1];
__STATIC_INLINE int clip(int x) { return x; }
VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debugCallback(void *ud);
int WINAPI wWinMain(void *h, void *p, void *c, int s);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (function_definition
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (identifier))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))))

========================================
Calling-convention macro as a type position
========================================

NAPI_CDECL baz(int a);
CALLBACK int handler(void);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))))

========================================
Diagnostic pragma macros stay statements
========================================

void f(void) {
  __diag_push();
  __diag_ignore("-Wunused");
  work();
  __diag_pop();
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (string_literal
              (string_content)))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list))))))

================================================================================
Generic qualifier macros the literal lists cannot enumerate
================================================================================

ASIO_DECL int connect();
FMT_API void report(const char* fmt, int code);

class MYLIB_API Widget {
public:
    void m() {}
};

enum class EXPORT_ENUM Color { Red, Green };

struct S {
    CUSTOM_MARKER
    int x;
    OTHER_MACRO(x, y)
    void n() {}
};

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_qualifier
      (identifier))
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list)))
  (declaration
    (macro_qualifier
      (identifier))
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_qualifier)
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (class_specifier
    (macro_qualifier
      (identifier))
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (access_specifier)
      (function_definition
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (function_declarator
          declarator: (field_identifier)
          parameters: (parameter_list))
        body: (compound_statement))))
  (declaration
    type: (enum_specifier
      name: (type_identifier))
    declarator: (init_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      value: (initializer_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier))))
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (macro_qualifier
          (identifier))
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (field_identifier))
      (function_definition
        (macro_qualifier
          (identifier)
          (macro_argument_list
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (function_declarator
          declarator: (field_identifier)
          parameters: (parameter_list))
        body: (compound_statement)))))

================================================================================
Post-type identifiers are never qualifiers (controls)
================================================================================

struct S { int name : 3 { 0 }; };
bool eq(const T& a, const T* b) { return a == *b; }
int Foo = 1;

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier)
        (bitfield_clause
          (number_literal))
        (initializer_list
          (number_literal)))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_qualifier)
          (type_identifier)
          (reference_declarator
            (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_qualifier)
          (type_identifier)
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))))
    (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (binary_expression
          (identifier)
          (pointer_expression
            (identifier))))))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (number_literal))))

================================================================================

typedef VOID(NTAPI* PIO_APC_ROUTINE)(PVOID ApcContext, _In_ PIO_STATUS_BLOCK IoStatusBlock);

int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE h, int s) { return 0; }
void g(int n) { delete [] p; }

    (function_declarator
      (parenthesized_declarator

          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier)))))

    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)

            (far_ptr_modifier)

          (pointer_declarator
            (far_ptr_modifier)
            (identifier))))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (macro_attribute)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier))

      (return_statement

================================================================================
Mid-position nested template arg in a parameter list
================================================================================

void reschedule_addr(
  std::priority_queue<DownstreamAddrEntry, std::vector<DownstreamAddrEntry>,
                      DownstreamAddrEntryGreater> &pq,
  DownstreamAddr *addr) {
  pq.push(DownstreamAddrEntry{addr, addr->seq, addr->cycle});
}
void g(T<A, U<B>, C> x) { }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (qualified_identifier
            (namespace_identifier)
            (template_type
              (type_identifier)
              (template_argument_list
                (type_descriptor
                  (type_identifier))
                (type_descriptor
                  (qualified_identifier
                    (namespace_identifier)
                    (template_type
                      (type_identifier)
                      (template_argument_list
                        (type_descriptor
                          (type_identifier))))))
                (type_descriptor
                  (type_identifier)))))
          (reference_declarator
            (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (field_expression
            (identifier)
            (field_identifier))
          (argument_list
            (compound_literal_expression
              (type_identifier)
              (initializer_list
                (identifier)
                (field_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (field_identifier))
                (field_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (field_identifier)))))))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (template_type
            (type_identifier)
            (template_argument_list
              (type_descriptor
                (type_identifier))
              (type_descriptor
                (template_type
                  (type_identifier)
                  (template_argument_list
                    (type_descriptor
                      (type_identifier)))))
              (type_descriptor
                (type_identifier))))
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement)))
